t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The colours are divided into groups and so stick with one colour until it reaches about 2 mushrooms and then switch to the other choice.

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes are split into groups by colour family [red-purple, pink, burgundy] [yellow-blue, green, orange]. Continue choosing the same colour family while the number of mushrooms they have is high [3-9]. When the number of mushrooms has gone down to 0-2, try the other colour family. Continue like this.
